# U101: Amara sets the check-in rhythm to none: Features → Change → No set rhythm reads back what changes, counted; saved, Home has no streak and nothing due, Goals has no “no recent update”, a quiet goal says which week its status is from, Activity has the entry and Undo restores it. Switched back on, nothing is late that day and the first check-ins’ date is said

- **Belongs to:** the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)); it runs with every module on, and the core journeys run again with each module left out
- **Requirements:** `RHYTHM-OPTIONAL`, `HOME-OWNER`, `CHANGE-LOG`
- **Budget:** at most 12 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** every point but `entry`, `parity` ([the ease test](../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Amara, at `/workspace/features` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U101

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Amara (`amara`).
- Go to `/workspace/features` in the demo.
- **Check:** “Check-in rhythm” is shown.
- **Check:** “Every week, due by Thursday.” is shown (else: Features does not say the rhythm is every week, due by Thursday).
- **Check:** It fails if with a rhythm Goals’ count line names no goal with no recent update: {goalsBefore}.
- Go to `/workspace/features` in the demo.
- **Step.** Press the “Change” button in the rhythm row (`.rhythm-row`).
- **Check:** The “Check-in rhythm” dialog shows.
- **Check:** It fails if Save is offered before anything changed.
- **Step.** Press the “No set rhythm” choice in the “Check-in rhythm” dialog.
- Repeated, as the code loops, 4 rows:
  - _Row:_ “N goals have nothing due.” (a pattern)
  - _Row:_ “stop reading “No recent update”” (a pattern)
  - _Row:_ “Nothing is flagged for going quiet.” (a pattern)
  - _Row:_ “Every check-in already posted stays as it is.” (a pattern)
  - **Check:** It fails if the read-back does not say {t}: {says.slice(0, 400)}.
- **Check:** (`attention`) scored as met here.
- **Step.** Press the “Save” button in the “Check-in rhythm” dialog.
- **Check:** “Check-ins have no set rhythm now.” is shown.
- **Check:** (`one-action`) scored as met here.
- **Check:** “No set rhythm. Owners check in when there’s news” is shown (else: Features does not say there is no set rhythm).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “none”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ Home: no streak, nothing due.
- Go to `/` in the demo.
- **Check:** Home shows.
- **Check:** It fails if Home with no set rhythm still says “{owed[0]}”.
- _Note:_ Goals: no “no recent update”; a status not from this week says which week.
- Go to `/goals?scope=all` in the demo.
- **Check:** The Goals count line shows.
- **Check:** It fails if Goals’ count line still names no recent update: {line}.
- **Check:** It fails if no goal on Goals says “as of week {n}”.
- _Note:_ Activity: the entry, under the workspace.
- **Check:** (`logged`) met when `s.changes.some((c) => c.entity === 'workspace' && c.actorId === 'amara' && c.summary === 'Changed the check-in rhythm from every week to no set rhythm')`, where `const s = await h.snapshot()`. Else it says: the rhythm change was not logged.
- _Note:_ Switched back on: nothing late that day, the first date said.
- Go to `/workspace/features` in the demo.
- **Step.** Press the “Change” button in the rhythm row (`.rhythm-row`).
- **Step.** Press the “Every week” choice in the “Check-in rhythm” dialog.
- **Check:** It fails if switching back on does not say when the first are due and that nothing is late: {back.slice(0, 400)}.
- **Step.** Press the “Save” button in the “Check-in rhythm” dialog.
- **Check:** “Check-ins are due every week, by Thursday.” is shown.
- Go to `/goals?scope=all` in the demo.
- **Check:** The Goals count line shows.
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `!/no recent update/i.test(fresh)`, where `const fresh = await p.locator('.goals-line').innerText()`. Else it says: switched back on, goals read No recent update on the same day: {fresh}.
- _Note:_ Undo, from the toast, puts the rhythm back as it was.
- Go to `/workspace/features` in the demo.
- **Step.** Press the “Change” button in the rhythm row (`.rhythm-row`).
- **Step.** Press the “No set rhythm” choice in the “Check-in rhythm” dialog.
- **Step.** Press the “Save” button in the “Check-in rhythm” dialog.
- **Check:** “Check-ins have no set rhythm now.” is shown.
- Press the last of the “Undo” button.
- **Check:** “The check-in rhythm is as it was.” is shown.
- **Check:** “Every week, due by Thursday.” is shown (else: Undo did not put the rhythm back).
- **Check:** (`progress`) scored as met here.
- **Check:** (`errors`) scored as met here.
- Close this browser.
